verdict.rationale: Morph publishes first-party integration guides for coding agents. A coding-agents guide covers Claude Code via the native /v1/messages endpoint and Codex with an edit_file tool, and an MCP guide connects AI tools to Fast Apply and Warp-Grep. A goose author also reports using Morph in practice. No first-party guide for agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain-style SDKs) appears in the evidence, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: documented first-party guides for agent frameworks, guides beyond Claude Code/Codex/MCP clients, independent hands-on corroboration of the guides themselves

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.
Keep your current Codex model and give it `edit_file` backed by `morph-v3-fast` at 10,500+ tok/s (no gateway)
Connect your favorite AI tools to Morph's blazing-fast file editing via Model Context Protocol.
Install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can read it
